basic_info.description: Investors and developers looking for a great location with stunning views- this single family home is likely a major remodel, a complete renovation, or a redevelopment project. Not for the faint of heart. Check out this 1908* Victorian Cottage (*tax record) on the sunny slope of Potrero Hill with views over Dogpatch looking toward the water and the East Bay. This project is ready for your imagination and vision. The lot is zoned RH-2, measures 25 x 100' and slopes downward for multi-level living with unobstructed views. There is a studio below the main house with a bath and separate entrance. Just two blocks to the Potrero Hill Rec Center to the south, and two blocks to the north to the charming local shops, restaurants and bars of 18th Street, and another to Whole Foods. With easy access to both the 101 and 280, commuting downtown or the south bay is a breeze. Conditions may require cash purchase. Buyer to investigate allowable lot and build options to their satisfaction. DO NOT DISTURB OCCUPANTS!
